_comment: Internal faults hidden until tested. part: specific part id, or 'battery'/'keys' to resolve from the model, or 'ram'/'storage' to resolve by type. weight = relative frequency. visible_condition links a fault to an external cosmetic tag (so it shows on hover AND in the test report).

faults.name: Dead SSD
faults.report: Dead SSD – SMART failure, 0 bytes readable

faults.name: Missing drive
faults.report: No boot device – drive removed by previous owner

faults.name: Noisy fan
faults.report: CPU fan bearing failing – 82 dB at load

faults.name: BIOS password lock
faults.report: BIOS supervisor password set – asset locked

faults.name: No POST (board)
faults.report: No POST – board fault (3 long beeps)

faults.name: Dead PSU
faults.report: PSU failed – no standby power, no fan spin

faults.name: Flat CMOS battery
faults.report: CMOS battery flat – BIOS clock and settings lost on power-off

faults.name: Dead front USB
faults.report: Front USB ports dead – header cable detached
